generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/delivery-batch-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/delivery.md in Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto or any @noble library. Secrets are SHA-256 of fixed labels: test data only.
